definitions.explanation: Heavy rain blown along by strong wind, so that it comes at a slant and soaks people even under umbrellas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}りだ。
examples.english: It's pouring with driving rain outside.
I walked to the station through the driving rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づき→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}たない→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}りになった。
examples.english: As the typhoon approached, from evening the rain was blowing so hard that umbrellas were useless.

notes:
From ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) + ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (to fall), with the second part voiced to ぶり. A somewhat old-fashioned weather word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}り: a fierce rainstorm
- {吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the driving rain
- {吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a rainstorm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横殴|よこなぐ}り→横殴り：32387_yokonaguri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain driven sideways — the more common everyday description
- ⟦{暴風雨|ぼうふうう}→暴風雨：07670_boufuuu⟧: storm with heavy rain — the forecast term
